description: Flexibility Market Research (SPEN_025) Data Quality Checks is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. This data table provides the detailed data quality assessment scores for the Flexibility Market Research dataset. The quality assessment was carried out on the 31st of January 2026. At SPEN, we are dedicated to sharing high-quality data with our stakeholders and being transparent about its' quality. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Supporting Information, Flexibility. Its keywords are Data Quality. The portal shows 2025-10-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
